question: Which of the following festivals is associated with the wedding of Goddess Meenakshi celebrated majorly in Tamil Nadu?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chithirai.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Chithirai Festival, also known as** Chithirai Thiruvizha or Meenakshi Kalyanam ,** is an annual Tamil Hindu celebration in the city of Madurai during the month of April.
 
• The Chariot festival, is performed the day after Meenakshi Kalyanam.
 
• The king and queen of the** Pandya Kingdom, Meenakshi and Sundareshwar **come to see their subjects in a well-decorated chariot. It attracts many people in the Masi streets of Madurai as viewers.

 [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcT3BKNTQq0SyGuG7oY6oG1Of4iXvANoNOo6Wg&usqp=CAU] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saga Dawa or the** Triple Blessed Festival is an auspicious month for the **Sikkimese Buddhists **with prayers held throughout the month in various monasteries
 
• **Porag** is a five-day** long post-harvest festival** observed by the Musings of Assam. Drummers and dancers belonging to a village are invited to perform in the neighboring village. They present their skills to their full potential, providing wholesome entertainment to those gathered at the venue.
 
• **Bihula** is a prominent festival of eastern Bihar and is especially famous in the** district of Bhagalpur.** During the festival, observed every August, devotees pray** to Goddess Mansa for the welfare of their families.**
